[LLEX.6.7.1] Triple-quoted strings (`"""…"""`) can span multiple lines. The
lexer does **not** track indentation inside a triple string;
line breaks and leading whitespace inside the literal are part
of the string value. The consumer applies the Python
`inspect.cleandoc` rule when it reads the literal's value
(strip the common leading whitespace on non-empty lines;
remove leading and trailing blank lines).
